english.title: Fail to declare goods carried / contained in baggage obtained outside the UK
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), failed to declare goods, namely **(..SPECIFY THE GOODS..),

(A)_[carried with you]_
(B)_[contained in your baggage]_

which you had obtained outside the United Kingdom and for which you were not entitled to exemption from duty or tax
english.legislation: Contrary to section 78(1) and (3) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) For the purposes of this section, anything carried by the person means carried by sea, air or train and includes clothing worn by the person.
(ii) THIS IS AN ABSOLUTE OFFENCE - therefore an offence is committed when a person fails to declare goods to which no exemption applies.
(iii) See section 49 for forfeiture provisions
